name: saygm-agent
description: GM Agent — a personal agent on top of the SayGM gateway with Ditto memory, pluggable engines (OpenCode / Claude Agent SDK) and its own web UI.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
